_comment: Escaping-heuristic resolutions (QUALITY.md §1.2): every flag is either fixed or recorded here as verified-clean, keyed by the exact interpolated expression. The heuristic re-fires if the expression text changes.

weather.html.temp(d.tempC): numeric formatter: Math.round() output or the literal em-dash — never remote text
weather.html.iconFor(d.desc, d.isDay).replace('width=: intentional markup: SVG built from a fixed local icon set; remote text only selects which icon
weather.html.iconFor(p.shortForecast, p.isDaytime): intentional markup: SVG from the fixed local icon set
weather.html.iconFor(r.desc, r.isDay): intentional markup: SVG from the fixed local icon set
weather.html.feels: built from temp() + U() locals only (numeric + unit constant)
weather.html.metrics.map(m=>`<div class=\"metric\"><d: intentional markup join; the cell contents are covered by the m[0]/m[1] entries
weather.html.m[1]: metric values: each is Suite.esc()'d or numeric-formatted where the metrics array is built
weather.html.desc.length>=240?\"…\":\"\": literal ellipsis appended after an esc()'d truncated string

almanac.html.countdown(s.date, now): local date math -> fixed English phrase
almanac.html.s.name: fixed four-element season names array
almanac.html.fmtDate(s.date): locale date string of a computed Date
almanac.html.fmtTime(s.date): locale time string of a computed Date
